title: What a fraction is
examples: Teacher, if I cut a pizza into eight slices, how do I write that as a fraction?
What does the bottom number of a fraction tell me?
Can you show me a unit fraction with circles?

explain.say: A fraction is a part of one whole thing. Look at one whole sandwich.
Cut the sandwich into two equal parts. Equal means the same size. Each part is one half.

draw.text: Equal parts are the same size

explain.say: Now cut a pizza into four equal parts. Each part is one quarter.
A fraction has two numbers. The bottom number tells how many equal parts there are. It is called the denominator.

draw.text: Bottom number: how many equal parts

explain.say: The top number tells how many parts you take. It is called the numerator. One part of four is written one over four.

draw.text: Top number: how many parts you take

faq.a: A unit fraction is any fraction where the top number, the numerator, is one. It means you are only counting one single part.
asks: What does it mean to have one over something?

faq.q: Does the whole have to be a shape?
faq.a: No, the whole can be anything you can share equally. It could be a group of sweets or an hour of time.
asks: Can I use people to show a fraction?
Does the whole have to be visible?

faq.q: Why do I need both a top and a bottom number?
faq.a: We need both numbers to know exactly what we are talking about. The bottom number tells us the total, and the top number tells us the count.
asks: Why can't I just use one number?
What does the denominator tell me?

faq.q: If I shade three parts out of eight, what is the fraction?
faq.a: You have three parts, so the top number is three. The whole is split into eight parts, so the bottom number is eight. The fraction is three over eight.
asks: How do I write 3 out of 8?
If I shade 3 parts, what number goes on top?

faq.q: Can I use fractions for things that are not cut?
faq.a: Yes, you can use fractions for parts of a group. For example, three out of five students wearing blue shirts.
asks: Can I count people for fractions?
Does it have to be cut into pieces?

facts: A fraction represents a part of a whole or a collection.
The denominator shows the total number of equal parts the whole is divided into.
The numerator shows how many of those equal parts are being counted.
A unit fraction always has a numerator of one.

quiz.say: The apple has two equal parts. Tap the fraction for one part.
quiz.why: There are 2 equal parts and you take 1. That is one half, written 1/2.

wrong.1: One quarter is 1 of 4 equal parts, and the apple has 2 parts.
wrong.2: The number 2 tells how many parts in all, and a fraction also shows the part you take.

quiz.say: Count the equal parts. Tap the bottom number for one part.
quiz.why: Count the equal parts: there are 4. The bottom number is 4.

wrong.0: The number 1 is the top number when you take one part.
wrong.2: There are 3 cuts in the bar, but there are 4 parts.

quiz.say: Look at the squares. Tap the fraction that is green.
quiz.why: 1 square of 4 equal squares is green. So the fraction is 1/4.

wrong.0: The bottom number counts all the squares, and there are 4 squares.
wrong.1: The number 3 counts the white squares, but the question asks about green.
